"use client"

import * as React from "react"
import { Tabs as TabsPrimitive } from "@base-ui/react/tabs"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import type { WithClassName } from "./_shared"

/*
 * Playdesk Tabs: the desk's segmented control. A recessed pill track holds the
 * segments; the active one lifts out as a white cap with its own shadow.
 */

const Tabs = TabsPrimitive.Root

const TabsList = React.forwardRef<
  HTMLDivElement,
  WithClassName<TabsPrimitive.List.Props>
>(({ className, ...props }, ref) => (
  <TabsPrimitive.List
    ref={ref}
    className={cn(
      "inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 rounded-full bg-secondary p-1 [box-shadow:var(--shadow-rim)]",
      className
    )}
    {...props}
  />
))
TabsList.displayName = "TabsList"

const TabsTrigger = React.forwardRef<
  HTMLButtonElement,
  WithClassName<TabsPrimitive.Tab.Props>
>(({ className, ...props }, ref) => (
  <TabsPrimitive.Tab
    ref={ref}
    className={cn(
      "inline-flex cursor-pointer items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap rounded-full px-4 py-1.5",
      "text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground",
      "transition-[background-color,color,box-shadow] duration-fast ease-out",
      "hover:text-foreground",
      "focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-[0.1875rem] focus-visible:ring-ring/35",
      "data-disabled:pointer-events-none data-disabled:opacity-50",
      "data-selected:bg-card data-selected:text-foreground",
      "data-selected:[box-shadow:var(--shadow-md)]",
      "[&_svg]:size-4 [&_svg]:shrink-0",
      className
    )}
    {...props}
  />
))
TabsTrigger.displayName = "TabsTrigger"

const TabsContent = React.forwardRef<
  HTMLDivElement,
  WithClassName<TabsPrimitive.Panel.Props>
>(({ className, ...props }, ref) => (
  <TabsPrimitive.Panel
    ref={ref}
    className={cn(
      "mt-4 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-[0.1875rem] focus-visible:ring-ring/35",
      className
    )}
    {...props}
  />
))
TabsContent.displayName = "TabsContent"

export { Tabs, TabsList, TabsTrigger, TabsContent }
